root_cause.text: In xe_sync_entry_parse, when dma_fence_chain_alloc() fails, the function returns -ENOMEM without releasing the previously obtained user fence reference (sync->ufence), causing a memory leak.

The commit message explicitly states: "When dma_fence_chain_alloc() fails, properly release the user fence reference to prevent a memory leak."
